entries.02dfea6bf4321907: Aiming to become a content production company that connects fans and content through emotion, it plans to pursue measures including expanding e-book services including 'Manga Ōkoku', differentiation through serialized works on 'Manga Ōkoku' including titles produced within the group, strengthening digital content and optimizing print publishing, and comicization and development of new genres.
